link.command_description: Link your Steam account (profile URL / SteamID64 / custom URL name)
unlink.success: ✅ Your Steam account has been unlinked.
unlink.not_linked: No linked Steam account was found.
profile.param_user_description: The user to check (defaults to yourself)
profile.not_linked: {mention} hasn't linked a Steam account yet.
games.command_description: Suggest a game to play today from the games VC members have in common
games.param_all_description: Show all common games without filtering to multiplayer-only titles
games.error_no_voice_channel:
❌ Please join a voice channel before running this command.
(Run this command in a text channel of a server that has a VC. It doesn't work in DMs.)
games.error_need_two_members:
❌ At least 2 members with a linked Steam account and a visible game library are required.
Use `/link` to link your account, and make sure "Game details" is set to public on Steam.
games.note_category_limit: Some games haven't been categorized yet and will be reflected next time
games.upsell_retry_unknown: Please wait a while and try again.
pick.command_description: Randomly suggest one game from the common library
pick.param_all_description: Pick from the entire common library without filtering to multiplayer-only titles
pick.title: 🎲 Today's pick!
grant.command_description: [Owner only] Grant premium to a server
grant.param_days_description: Number of valid days (unlimited if omitted)
revoke.command_description: [Owner only] Revoke manually granted premium from a server
revoke.success: ✅ Revoked the manually granted premium from server `{guild_id}`.
revoke.not_found: Server `{guild_id}` has no manually granted premium on record.
common.param_guild_id_description: Target server ID (defaults to the current server)
common.owner_only_error: ❌ This command can only be run by the bot owner.
link_finalize.embed_title: Your Steam account has been linked
link_finalize.private_profile_warning:
Your profile appears to be private.
Enable "Game details" in your Steam privacy settings, otherwise your game library can't be fetched.
link_finalize.zero_games_warning: You have 0 owned games, or "Game details" visibility may be turned off.
